# Vir Electric

> Full-service electrical contractor in El Paso, Texas providing commercial, industrial, and residential electrical solutions.

Vir Electric is a certified electrical contracting company serving El Paso and West Texas with expertise across commercial, industrial, and residential projects. The company offers comprehensive electrical services including new construction, remodeling, emergency repairs, and specialized industrial work.
